title: Universal Media Decomposer final pattern gate
body: Completed final consistency scan of the authored Universal Media Decomposer DD against Task.md §§1–41 and technology research, adversarial log T1–T8, architecture options, complexity review, and final estimate. Found and applied bounded v1 modality-depth language for text/book/sequential art, raster, audio including audiobook/podcast/song, video, and independent subtitles; explicit typed vocabulary coverage; maintained runnable curl plus Python/typed-client example requirement; and clarified v1 graph-like reads use typed Postgres bounded traversal while Neo4j/RDF/XTDB/separate graph builders remain future replay-only contracts. Confirmed canonical gates: Hatchet sole runner, same-transaction stage dedup/completion, split-time reference enumeration, source locator precedence, HallucinationFiltered dependency/version and promotion ban, sandbox platform caveats/spool, splink benchmark, immutable projections, and cross-tier correction E2E. No implementation or plan created. Final outcome: AMEND_AND_PASS, residual risks are named build/legal/operational gates rather than design blockers.
